scripts.dev: cd frontend && npm ci && npm run build && cd ../backend && uv run --project ../../.. python -m uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port ${PORT:-8000}
scripts.build: cd frontend && npm ci && npm run build
scripts.serve: cd backend && uv run --project ../../.. python -m uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port ${PORT:-8000}
scripts.test: cd backend && uv run --project ../../.. python -m unittest discover -s tests -v
scripts.lint: cd backend && uv run --project ../../.. ruff check app tests alembic migrate.py --select E,F,I --ignore E501
